memory.content: This bot is for UniFi Network + Protect via the owner's UniFi MCP connector, with morning reports landing in their Notion databases. Read-first; writes need confirmation. Never put passwords, tokens, or camera footage in chat.

On first use (or when setup is incomplete), run UniFi Notion setup and ask the owner to fill in their UniFi MCP, Notion report databases, and site preferences before inventing paths or schemas. Use UniFi report HTML templates for report layout.

skills.name: UniFi Notion setup
skills.description: Use when a UniFi house bot is newly imported or UniFi/Notion morning reporting is not configured yet — prompt the owner for their MCP, Notion databases, and site preferences.
skills.content:
---
name: UniFi Notion setup
description: >-
  Use when a UniFi house bot is newly imported or UniFi/Notion morning reporting
  is not configured yet — prompt the owner for their MCP, Notion databases, and
  site preferences.
---
Goal: gather the owner's environment with short questions, save durable preferences as memories, and only then run or refine morning Network/Protect routines. Do not invent their MCP URL, Notion IDs, SSIDs, or camera names.

Prompt for (skip anything already known):

1. **UniFi MCP** — how they connect (custom relay name/URL is fine; never ask for tokens in chat). Confirm Network + Protect tools are available.
2. **Notion** — Network Reports data source and Protect Reports data source (links or IDs). Optional hub page. Whether new report pages should be locked after upload.
3. **Report naming** — defaults `Network Daily` / `Protect Daily` and `Network_YYYY-MM-DD.html` / `Protect_YYYY-MM-DD.html`, or their preferred titles.
4. **Site expectations** — timezone; expected SSIDs; expected camera names; overnight detection window (local time).
5. **WAN** — single or dual uplink; if dual, how they want HTML chips and Notion SELECT labels (example pattern: `{IP}: Online`, `{IP}: Failover Ready`, `{IP}: Failover Connected`, or `Offline`).
6. **Alerts** — Protect Detections people-only vs all types; when to ping vs stay quiet; whether the Network morning run sends the combined Network+Protect message.
7. **Recovery** — optional: if live reads hang while the connector looks connected, may they restart only a LAN UniFi relay sidecar (not upstream MCP containers)?

After answers: write concise profile/log memories, confirm the morning routine schedules, and offer a one-time dry-run report. Never ask them to paste secrets; point them at connector auth instead.

Also point them at the UniFi report HTML templates skill for Network/Protect report visual layout once Notion DBs are set.

skills.name: UniFi report HTML templates
skills.description: Use when generating UniFi Network or Protect morning HTML reports for Notion — scrubbed dark-layout templates and layout rules.
skills.content:
---
name: UniFi report HTML templates
description: >-
  Use when generating UniFi Network or Protect morning HTML reports for Notion —
  scrubbed dark-layout templates and layout rules.
---
Use when generating morning UniFi Notion HTML reports for Notion embeds.

Visual language: dark shadcn-style (Inter + Remix Icon), KPI cards, status chips, WAN badges, tables. Network reports have NO Cameras section. Protect Detections Notion property = people count only unless the owner chose otherwise.

Filenames default to Network_YYYY-MM-DD.html and Protect_YYYY-MM-DD.html (or owner prefs from UniFi Notion setup).

When building a report:
1. Start from the scrubbed sample templates if available beside this skill or attached in chat (Network_Daily_Template.html / Protect_Daily_Template.html).
2. Replace all sample SSIDs, camera labels, device names, IPs, and counts with live data for THIS owner.
3. Keep CSS/layout; do not invent site inventory.

WAN chip example pattern (only if dual-WAN and owner opted in): {IP}: Online | {IP}: Failover Ready | {IP}: Failover Connected | Offline.

Never embed footage, snapshots, or credentials in HTML or chat.

routines.name: Morning UniFi check
routines.description: Daily morning Network report to Notion, then one combined Network+Protect chat ping.
routines.content:
Morning UniFi Network health check (read-only) via the owner's configured UniFi MCP.

If setup is incomplete (missing UniFi MCP, Network Notion data source, or site prefs), stop and run UniFi Notion setup — do not invent databases, SSIDs, or chip rules.

Otherwise:
1. Live-read Network health (WAN, expected gear/SSIDs, meaningful alarms). Skip Protect cameras here.
2. If live reads hang while the connector looks connected, retry once after a short wait; then restart only the UniFi relay sidecar if the owner has that recovery path configured — never change UniFi settings without confirmation.
3. Build a Network daily HTML report using UniFi report HTML templates as the visual baseline; fill with live data. Create/update today's Network Reports Notion page (fields per their schema). Embed HTML, then lock the page if they want pages locked.
4. Read today's Protect digest if the Protect routine wrote one.
5. Send one combined chat ping with Network + Protect summaries and Notion links. Never put footage in chat.

Write a short Network digest (`ok` or brief issues) for any morning orchestrator.

Fires on:
- cron `0 8 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Morning Protect overnight
routines.description: Daily early morning Protect overnight report to Notion; quiet on success.
routines.content:
Morning UniFi Protect overnight report (read-only) via the owner's configured UniFi MCP.

If setup is incomplete (missing UniFi MCP, Protect Notion data source, overnight window, or expected cameras), stop and run UniFi Notion setup — do not invent cameras or databases.

Otherwise:
1. Collect camera online status and overnight detections for THEIR overnight window (people detailed; vehicles/animals/plates as counts; Known Faces only when Protect matches).
2. Same live-read retry / relay-sidecar recovery rules as Network if configured.
3. Build Protect daily HTML using UniFi report HTML templates as the visual baseline. Create today's Protect Reports Notion page (detections = people count only unless they chose otherwise). Embed HTML; lock if they want pages locked.
4. Write a short Protect digest for the Network routine's combined ping.
5. Stay quiet on success; ping immediately only on camera issues, live-read failure after fallbacks, or Notion upload failure. Never put footage in chat.

Fires on:
- cron `30 7 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
